summary: Rewrote the Prompt Architecture section of orchestrator/docs/architecture.md to reflect the partial-based system. Removed all references to PROJECT_PATH_REMINDER and WP_SCOPE_REMINDER constants and their import from src/nodes/__init__.py. Replaced the two-variant code examples (minimal + SCOPE RESTRICTION) with the single unified WP-scoped pattern passing only project_path and wp_id. Updated the Field Reference table to show the actual variables (project_path + wp_id for WP-scoped, project_path + plan_file + extra for PM, project_path for synthesis). Fixed the PM and Synthesis template descriptions. Added a new Template Partials subsection documenting the {{> partial-name}} mechanism and all 5 partials. Added a new Module-Level Template Caching subsection documenting the _TEMPLATE = load_template('stage') convention. Updated the Two-layer prompt scope reinforcement section to reference partials instead of deprecated Python constants. Updated the project_path Reminder subsection to describe the partial include rather than the old constant. In constraints.md, updated Constraint 1's correct pattern to show the module-level _TEMPLATE caching convention. Note: orchestrator/docs/public-api.md (outside WP scope) still contains stale references to PROJECT_PATH_REMINDER and WP_SCOPE_REMINDER - flagged for a follow-up work package.

comments.note: All 7 acceptance criteria verified. architecture.md grep confirms zero occurrences of PROJECT_PATH_REMINDER, WP_SCOPE_REMINDER, project_path_reminder, wp_scope_reminder, or 'from src.nodes import'.

constraints.md already had no stale constant names (grep confirmed). Updated only the correct-pattern code block in Constraint 1 to use module-level _TEMPLATE caching, aligning it with the actual implementation.

Out-of-scope stale file: orchestrator/docs/public-api.md lines 64-65 still document PROJECT_PATH_REMINDER and WP_SCOPE_REMINDER as public exports of src.nodes. This file was outside the WP-002 scope but should be addressed in a follow-up.
